acceptance_criteria: CODE-001: multiline, CRLF, and tab-bearing admitted excerpts preserve visible semantics in Markdown, HTML, and extracted PDF. CODE-002: retry refuses an incomplete active provider attempt and cancel/retry concurrency preserves attempt identity. SEC-003: a resealed substituted PDF fails stage verification despite self-consistent hashes and metadata. INTEGRATION-001: the website accepts authentic native v4 results while retaining v2/v3 compatibility and rejecting mixed, stale, altered, false-complete, and future-version inputs. SEC-004: protected mutation and result/download paths re-authorize after awaited work. DEP-001: privileged deployment actions use exact commit SHAs and deploy-only OIDC scope. DEMOS-001: Cargo-built proof is labeled source-built, with installed proof claimed only when actually exercised. Every finding maps to an exact fix and proving test; independent exact-head review and applicable CI are required.
